items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Tizol, Juan Tizol, we were very friendly with him

ctx.x: Who all did you know in the band well?

Well, I knew Barney and Johnny and Harry and Rex, and of course I knew Lawrence, but Lawrence was always the utmost -- the gentleman all the time and rather reserved, but a real nice fellow. And Tizol, Juan Tizol, we were very friendly with him, and Sonny. Of course

everybody that's met Sonny is his friend right off the bat. And -- well, let's see, Paul wasn't with the band yet there. Toby, Otto Hardwick, he and I became very good friends. I was practically friends with the whole band.

items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Charlie Barnett, I had something that I wrote for myself when I gave it to Charlie

ctx.x: You were saying about played with Charlie Barnett?

Yeah, Charlie Barnett, I had something that I wrote for myself when I gave it to Charlie, I wrote it for the boys in the band while they were rehearsing, and they used it -- and they used it for quite awhile. The first time when it came on the radio ...
With Charlie Barnett? The opening theme.
